briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate multi-agent systems as China deploys DeepSeek-R3 at scale

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with frontier labs releasing coordinated agent frameworks. Compute shortages persist while regulatory scrutiny grows in the EU and US. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI o4-preview demonstrates 40% gains in agent orchestration. xAI Colossus-2 and Google Gemini 3.0 edge toward real-time multi-agent collaboration. Meta's Llama 4.5 open release sparks new fine-tuning wave.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New NIST guidelines target agentic AI risks. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ships 2nm AI chips to Microsoft and Amazon. Saudi Arabia announces $40B AI data center cluster. Energy constraints delay three US hyperscale builds.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialect negotiation become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
